description: Score how hard a piece of English writing is to read. Send the text (up to 12,000 characters). Get back the Flesch Reading Ease score (higher is easier; 60 to 70 is plain English) and the Flesch-Kincaid grade level (a US school grade), with the word, sentence and syllable counts behind them, the two formulas worked with your numbers, and the words per sentence and syllables per word. The text is only counted: it is never stored and never sent back. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/reading-level-score). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

text.description: The English text to score (1 to 12,000 characters, Latin letters). Used only to count; never stored or echoed back. Emails and Social Security number shapes are refused.
